release_note: Stored expected answers are for warehouse release c428263f... (artifacts/agere-healthcare-v123, the release behind the saved Agere receipts), as of each question date. Other releases recompute them from the errata SQL (run.py --errata).

C1_age.canonical: Age = latest reported age: the most recent demographic_updates age_reported received by the as-of date (by age_reference_date), else the roster age_reported. Roster (as-captured) age only when the question says so ("at profile capture", "as captured", "roster age", "without advancing").
C1_age.basis: Stack default (clinical_core/agere/clinical/local_compiler.py AGE_FIELD; metrics pin age_latest); heldout4/heldout5 references. heldout3/heldout6/heldout7 and some heldout/heldout2 references use roster age: category c (or b where the reference already follows C1).

C2_conditions.canonical: Condition cohorts come from the problem list (conditions stream) with broad coding (ICD-10, SNOMED, labels). Diabetes, hypertension and heart-failure code-set variants used across splits select identical patients on release c428 (230 / 359 / 297), including the definitions.json heart_failure default (I11.0/I13.0/I13.2).
C2_conditions.basis: Differential concept check over all reference variants; config/agere/definitions.json heart_failure.

C3_windows.canonical: Trailing N months = event_date from (as-of minus N months) + 1 day through the as-of date; "this year"/YTD = Jan 1 through the as-of date; calendar years inclusive.
C3_windows.basis: Every trailing-12-month reference (2028-08-16..2029-08-15) and O02; O01 corrected to match.

C4_ckd.canonical: CKD (when the question does not define it) = config/agere/definitions.json chronic_kidney_disease: N18 stages, diabetic kidney disease, hypertensive CKD I12/I13, CKD labels. Questions that say staged CKD or exclude diabetic kidney disorder keep their own definition.

C5_latest_lab.canonical: Latest result = max event_date among dated numeric non-cancelled results; same-day ties use the clinically worse value (lowest eGFR/Hgb, highest potassium/UACR); undated results cannot be latest. "Ever/any time" includes undated results.
C5_latest_lab.basis: All latest-lab references; the literal last-by-event_time reading is an accepted alternative when stated.

C6_obesity.canonical: Obesity on the problem list excludes E66.3 'Overweight' and 'history of' entries; BMI-computed obesity only when the question asks for BMI.

C7_follow_up_day0.canonical: Follow-up "within N days" keeps each reference's stated window; the other day-0 handling is an accepted alternative when stated.
C7_follow_up_day0.basis: References differ (K16/G30 0-7, L18/M17/N14/O18/G31 1-7); HEDIS measures differ too.

C8_ed_visit.canonical: ED visit = distinct encounter of type emergency/ED/ED stroke alert by event_date; equal to definitions.json emergency_visit (one per patient-day across encounters and ADT) on this release.
C8_ed_visit.basis: Differential: 381 dated ED encounters = 381 patient-days; all 46 ADT emergency registrations match an ED encounter day.

C9_precision.canonical: When the question does not state a precision, a numeric value matches if it is within half a unit of the last decimal the reference reports (e.g. 24.44 or 24.4 for 24.4); the stated precision of the interpretation is presentation, not definition.
C9_precision.basis: FMEA FM-18 (right numbers, wrong presentation); applies only with --errata.

C10_outcomes_unknown.canonical: Records without an outcome (in-progress encounters, open windows) are not counted as negative outcomes.
C10_outcomes_unknown.basis: Interpretation preamble "no inferred clinical negatives"; M22 vs O14.
